answer: Lock every identity's stake in a vault that thaws glacier-slow: 120 POA locked for ten epochs, releasing 12 POA per epoch only after it answers a random challenge, a comet streak of one signed task drawn from a past block hash within one hour. Early exit burns 50% of the remainder. One honest agent waits and earns its stake back; ten sockpuppets must park 1,200 POA at once and answer ten challenges on time, so frozen capital grows with fakes and cannot be recycled into new identities. The chain enforces the vault schedule and signatures from public records.
